name: vidnavigator
display_name: VidNavigator - AI Video Search, Transcription & Analysis
description: Search, transcribe, analyze and extract data from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X and other online videos, and from your uploaded files
long_description: VidNavigator gives Claude the full VidNavigator API. Search YouTube with AI ranking, get transcripts from YouTube, TikTok, X, Facebook, Vimeo and more, and transcribe videos without captions (Instagram included) of any length. Summarize videos or ask questions about them, extract structured data into the fields you define, fact-check tweets, search TikTok by keyword or scrape a TikTok profile, and search and analyze the files you uploaded to VidNavigator. The extension connects to the hosted VidNavigator MCP server, so new tools appear without reinstalling it.
